maldives.title: Flag of the Republic of Maldives

colors.note: Represents the blood of national heroes and their willingness to sacrifice
Represents peace, prosperity, and the nation's date palms
The crescent representing Islam, the state religion

desc:
- Red field with a green rectangle at the centre bearing a white vertical crescent opening towards the fly
- Adopted on 25 July 1965, the day Maldives gained independence from the British protectorate
trivia:
- The earlier flags of the Maldives Sultanate were plain red until a black-and-white hoist was added in the early 20th century
- Maldives is one of the lowest-lying nations on Earth, with an average elevation of about 1.5 metres
- The flag adopted at independence was largely a simplification of the pre-independence design by removing the black-and-white striped hoist
